card.name: Spots just before drug interference statements
card.fires_on: Points in drug-interaction text where the next words are likely to say that something interferes with or alters absorption or effect. Seen on a number or space before a table of interacting drugs, on drug or supplement names such as biotin and omeprazole, and on timing words in dosing instructions.
